newsitem.title: FRANCE: First French bullfighter of Arab descent debuts.
newsitem.headline: First French bullfighter of Arab descent debuts.

text.p: France's first bullfighter of Arab descent made a successful weekend debut in the bulls festival in his southern hometown of Arles, France-3 television said on Monday.
Rachid Ouramdane, nicknamed "El Morenito" (the little dark one), was awarded one ear for each of the two bulls he killed.
"The bull does not ask me if I am black or white. I am there to fight it," he told France-3.
Ouramdane was born in Arles, the son of a "harki" -- an Algerian who fought in the colonial French army in Algeria's war of independence.
He studied at the local bullfighting school and is still a "novillero", a junior bullfighter facing only young bulls.
Another junior bullfighter of Arab descent, "Mohammed of Arles" is soon to make his debut in France.
